unreadable: IO01/IO03/IO45/IO46 and silkscreen IO37/IO36/IO35: O vs 0 not distinguishable; 0 used.
uncertain: Right header positions 4-6: callout labels print "NC" but the board silkscreen next to the same holes reads IO37, IO36, IO35; recorded label NC with silkscreen in functions. Which is correct is unresolved.
Pin order: one image holds a rear view (labels, no USB) and a front view (USB-C at bottom). Rule 9 applied per view (top-first); if the whole image counts, USB-nearest would reverse both headers.
notes: Function-only lists (Camera, SSD1306, AXP2101, Microphone, Pir, Boot) have no physical positions and were skipped. JST-GH 1.25mm battery connector (pins not labeled), USB-C and front-view header pads (same holes, unlabeled) not transcribed. Silkscreen next to the header reads IO01, TXD, RXD, IO37/36/35 as "IO001, IO37..." - only differing spellings added.
